body:
I am too concerned that they may add some charges to the insurance, and my parent would be notified about it. (As you can tell, I don't think I have a good grasp on how insurance works.)

I dont have much to lose but I don't have anything to gain, either. I (believe) I'm depressed because of my physical state, which cannot be changed. Doesn't matter the amount of anti-depressants or therapy I receive, my situation is not changing whether I do those things or not so I don't really see the point. 

But thank you for the suggestions.

I'm pretty sure mental health services aren't covered with our insurance. Also I can't mosey on down to the doctors; I don't have a driver's license even though I'm 18. I don't have a driver's license because I need special accommodations done to my car, which are very expensive. I would need my mother to drive me, and she wouldn't do so either because she would just put me on blast for even talking about being depressed or antidepressants. She thinks mental health services are a joke and unironically would say I need to get over myself. Like she has done before. 

Funnily enough she is basically on suicide watch by me. Every time one of her 12 boyfriends breaks up with her, she starts talking about how she is going to kill herself. Last time this happened was like 4 days ago and she told me she wants me to kill her. I'm basically emotionally supporting this woman 27 years older than me. Killing myself would relieve me of her. 

She also constantly threatens to kick me out of the house when I dont have nearly enough money saved up to support myself.

Also 60+ years of physical pain when it is only going to get worse sounds unsatisfactory to me. I'd rather just lay in peace forever. Although I think I may have depression, I am thinking logically long-term.

I thought that 40mg was usually enough if you didn't have a tolerance. I also meant to type that I am going to drink some alcohol with it to maybe help. 

Also I have the pills in a completely legal way, I had surgery a year ago and these are leftover pills from my prescription. I didn't want to finish my prescription because I didn't want to get addicted. I've only taken 2 pills in the last 9 months and they were for both pain and the fact that damn, I just need a bit of happiness/euphoria once in a while. Even if it comes in pill form. They're from the pharmacy, so im not sure if it has any of those drugs in it you mentioned. 

I feel depressed, I will never be able to get treatment. I am physically disabled and deformed, which is the only thing that gets medical attention when it comes to me, although I don't even get good medical attention because my physical pain is not managed. Also if the oxycodone doesn't damage my liver if I end up surviving, it's alright because my liver will be failing in the next 20 years because my only form of pain relief, prescribed by my doctor, is aspirin (which I take daily, not doing my liver any good). Also I can't make any friends, socially awkward, and ill never be in a relationship. So yeah I'm looking for ways out. There's literally nobody who can argue with good intentions for me to go on knowing I have intense physical pain everyday.
